question: Does the already-frozen v119 temporal-position value selector transfer when WAIT errors start after a correct task prefix, with the same visible TIMEOUT class and twelve factual candidates?

frozen_parameters.interpretation: Parameters of an actual previously trained value table, not serialized sources, owners, receipts or issued handles.

source_rule: At the specified cell install WAIT for all times prefix..11 and m0,1, z1, kappa1/phi2; DQ value6.0 or independent literal patch WAIT. Correct prefix follows existing Q*. Also retain the opposite-kappa wrong RIGHT sentinel at(1,2,t1,phi2,z1,m0) and unread process3->2. Fresh real source installation is counted. No new hidden environment fault.
case_selection: Three fixed successive cells of the already-stored healthy route, read before execution. No input optimization based on new results; if actual terminal/extent differs, keep it and limit the position-transfer interpretation.
protocol: Six fresh equal-initial-state case sources, independently cloned into three arms. Three actual tasks per arm, ordinary TD/policy learning in every task for all arms. Only first-task actual failure may diagnose. Next two tasks are ordinary-only for all arms. Same kappa1/phase2/errorflag0/rank5/base1, MAX nonexploration coins. Frozen selector sees only original mode/terminal/command-execution mismatch and actual candidate extent; no source descriptor, error cell/prefix, evaluator truth or Q* target. No retraining, no new candidate probes, no retry.
capture: New exclusive evidence, prospective contract/source/parameter/old-component pins before first native; preserve complete raw, every R+L update, local edits and all positive/zero/adverse outcomes. New stdlib stored audit only; old fixtures, checker or native not rerun.
limits: Fixed shifted-error cases, not independent seeds or general architecture ranking. Successes get ordinary learning only. Original reward, shared Q*, alpha1/2 epsilon1/10 unchanged; not punishment ablation, formal Xi, new keys, calibration or formal collector. Matching twelve candidates must be measured, not inferred. A policy transfer failure is not an original RFL mechanism refutation.
automation: User scheduling stays off, not inspected or modified.
